hens_rule_text: up to 4 female fowl (hens) over one month old per property
permit_notes: No permit requirement appeared in the code extracts; not confirmed either way.
setback_notes: Enclosure must be at least 30 feet from any residential dwelling other than the owner's.
coop_rules: Fowl must be kept in an enclosure.
zoning_notes: The four-hen cap applies citywide; roosters and male peafowl are prohibited.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.
